The cost and revenue functions of a product
are given by c(x) = 20x + 4000 and R(x) = 60x +
2000 respectively, where x is the number of
items produced and sold. The value of x to
earn profit is
solutionText:
Given, C(x) = 20x + 4000
R(x) = 60x + 2000
x = number of items produced and sold
To earn profit, R(x) - C(x) > 0
⇒ 60x + 2000 - 20x - 4000 > 0
⇒ 40x - 2000 > 0
⇒ 40x > 2000
⇒ x > 50
